create_image_handler: create an ImageHandler to subscribe to a ROS image topic and convert frames to OpenCV numpy arrays
create_camera_info_handler: create a CameraInfoHandler to subscribe to a ROS camera info topic and retrieve the camera matrix and distortion parameters
publish_image: use an ImagePublisher to publish an OpenCV numpy image to a ROS topic with a given encoding and frame id
create_point_handler: create a PointHandler to subscribe to a ROS PointStamped topic and retrieve the latest 3D point data
publish_pose: use a PosePublisher to publish a 3D position and unit quaternion pose to a ROS topic as a PoseStamped message
